title: Code for: Solving Linear Programs with Design of Experiments: Extreme-Vertices Designs, Constrained Steepest Ascent, and Noisy Objectives
description: Python code reproducing all tables and figures of the manuscript: extreme-vertices design and constrained steepest ascent routes to the LP optimum, comparison with the tableau simplex method, and the noisy-objective study. Test problems are from H. A. Taha, Operations Research: An Introduction, 10th ed.
notes: Funded by Umm Al-Qura University, Saudi Arabia, grant number 26UQU4400075GSSR05.
